resources.string: Preview apps at the top, middle or bottom. Keep the position or let it revert.
Automatic contrast follows the theme background. Choose light or dark ink for busy artwork. No text outlines or label backgrounds.
Show every app name, just the selected name, or none. Icon size, spacing and remote navigation stay the same.
Choose the border around the selected app. Strong uses a light and dark outline for mixed artwork.
Add space between app tiles without changing their order.
Play the theme’s local video silently while Home is visible. Reduced motion and device support may disable playback.
Save up to five Home setups per profile. Restore appearance and app choices without changing TV settings or accounts.
Show an Inputs shortcut on Home. TVs list their inputs; streamers provide guidance for the connected TV.
Hide app controls after a quiet period on Home. The first navigation press brings them back. Volume and Input still work.
